title: Light Mexican Vegetable Tlayudas
description: A plant-based friendly Mexican dish featuring crispy tlayudas topped with a variety of vegetables and a hint of Thai fish sauce, all held together with a mortar-pestle-pound technique.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush both sides of the corn tortillas with olive oil and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, saute the red onion, zucchini, bell pepper, and mushrooms over medium-high heat until the vegetables are tender.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the sauteed vegetables with Thai fish sauce, lime juice, and salt until coarsely chopped.
To assemble the tlayudas, place a baked tortilla on a flat surface and spoon some of the vegetable mixture onto the center of the tortilla.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top of the vegetable mixture and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the tlayudas hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
